2026-05-06 — v1.0.0-beta.1 fully released + post-release residue/deps cleanup landed.

RELEASE STATE:
- v1.0.0-beta.1 SHIPPED: tag 0238934 pushed, GitHub release published 2026-05-07T03:46Z with all 4 platform binaries, Homebrew tap auto-updated, install verified locally (rvr-beta -V → 1.0.0-beta.1).
- MCP server in Claude Code session is the new v1.0.0-beta.1 binary (verified by reverie_set actually writing to .reverie/).

DONE THIS SESSION (3 commits, all on origin/main):
- dec9547 rebrand(residue): CODEX_TMPFILE → RVR_TMPFILE in src/commands/entries.ts (functional, was missed in deep-rebrand env-var cutover); init help text in src/formatting.ts + src/completions.ts now says .reverie/; scripts/stress-test.mjs full cutover (env vars CODEX_* → RVR_*, MCP tool names codex_* → reverie_*, temp prefix codexcli-stress- → reverie-stress-, redundant marker file dropped); README.md prose; docs/release-checklist.md + docs/ROADMAP.md prose.
- 3187657 rebrand(residue): src/utils/directoryStore.ts and src/config.ts comment-noun cleanup (3 spots); .reverie/project.name (codexcli → reverie) and .reverie/project.repo (github.com/seabearDEV/codexCLI → /reverie) refreshed via reverie_set.
- 56d19e9 build(deps): npm audit fix bumped hono 4.12.14 → 4.12.16 and ip-address 10.1.0 → 10.1.1, closing 3 moderate Dependabot alerts (all transitive via @modelcontextprotocol/sdk). Lockfile-only. 0 vulns remaining.
- 1392/1392 tests, build, lint all clean throughout.

REBRAND RESIDUE AUDIT (B-bucket): src/utils/paths.ts (24 refs), src/store.ts (7), src/utils/envelope.ts, src/projectResolution.ts, .gitignore, migration tests, CHANGELOG, design docs ALL reviewed and confirmed legitimate back-compat / historical record. NOT residue. Don't re-audit.

NEXT SESSION PICKS UP:
- Soak the .codexcli/ → .reverie/ auto-migration on a real non-trivial existing store outside this repo. This repo's own migration during impl session doesn't count as a user-facing soak.
- After soak, decide v1.0.0-beta.2 (Phase 2 — Bun commit-phase + short-flag audit) vs jump to v1.0.0 stable.

PARKED (do NOT reopen unless user does):
- bun.lock + .mcp.json untracked — Phase 2 decisions.
- Legacy ccli.rb / ccli-beta.rb formulas in homebrew-reverie tap — separate repo, queued for v1.0.0 stable cleanup.
- rvr migrate-claude-md command — deferrable post-launch.

OPEN WORKSTREAMS USER MAY PICK UP:
- Phase 4 commercial: SeaBear product page, consulting tier/pricing, inquiry response template, Reverie for Teams landing.
- Phase 5 launch: blog post (bicameral story + codexCLI → Reverie narrative), Dogfooding Part Three, GitHub-inbound outreach.
- Workstream 3 visual: logo/wordmark, color palette, marketing site at seabear.dev/reverie.

GOTCHAS:
- The "remote: GitHub found 3 vulnerabilities" message on push after 56d19e9 is a stale Dependabot snapshot — Dependabot re-scans async, alerts auto-close shortly after push.
- git tag <name> creates lightweight tags; after git push origin main --follow-tags, also push the tag explicitly. (Bit us on v1.0.0-beta.0.)

DON'T (next bootstrap):
- Re-do work in dec9547 / 3187657 / 56d19e9.
- Re-audit B-bucket back-compat references — already cleared.
- Cut another release tag autonomously — user-driven moment.

USER STATE: Two productive sessions on 2026-05-06 — first shipped v1.0.0-beta.1, second cleaned post-release residue + deps. Steady, controlled cadence. Reasonable expectation for next session: real-world soak verification, then theme-pick for what comes next.
